name: Blocks at positions
description: Blocks as elements: an element of the type Block lives in a category (permissions, versions, translations) and is shown at positions of the template, e.g. contact details in the footer, a notice above all pages or links in the sidebar. Blocks are never listed and not in the search.
author: Enterprise Wiki

permissions.label: Edit blocks of the whole site
permissions.description: Change blocks that are shown on the whole site (placed for the template, the site or an element type).

limits.label: Blocks offered for placing
limits.help: How many blocks the placement lists at most (those the person may see).
